σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τάφροιο: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after ἰθύς: ’straight at the ditch’
τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’)
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., in apposition: ’young, offspring’ (τέκος ἐλάφοιο ’the young of a deer’)
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that’ (τήν γε μάχην ’that battle’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’)
ταῦτά: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’, accented before an enclitic · also elided ταῦτ’
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’)
τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before an enclitic: ’a (man)’ · also masc. acc. sg. with a negative: ’no one’ (οὔ τινά φημι ’I say no one’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μῆτιν: ’some’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’of this man’
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τυδέϊ: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. dat. sg., uncontracted -έϊ
τυδεΐδη: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. voc. sg., in address
τυδεΐδῃ: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. dat. sg. (patronymic)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’)
φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε)
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
φαρέτρην: φαρέτρη — quiver; fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (Ionic η for α; Attic φαρέτρᾱν)
φιλεῖ: φιλέω — love, hold dear; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’loves’
φορῆναι: φορέω — carry, bear; pres. inf., epic -ῆναι (= Attic φορεῖν)
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φύλασσε: φυλάσσω — guard, watch over; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’guard!’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφύλασσε): ’was keeping watch’
φῖλαι: φιλέω — love, befriend; aor. imper. 2 sg., old athematic form (= Attic φίλησον): ’befriend!’
χῶρος: χῶρος — place, spot; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg. · also the proper name Ἀγήνωρ — Agenor, a Trojan leader; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὸς: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθήνῃ: Ἀθήνη — Athena; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Ἀθηνᾷ)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address
ἀκὴν: ἀκήν — silent, in silence; adv. (frozen acc. of ἀκή), predicative: ’still, silent’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμύντορος: Ἀμύντωρ — Amyntor, father of Phoenix; masc. gen. sg.
ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
ἀρήρει: ἀραρίσκω — fit, fit together; plpf. 3 sg. with intransitive impf. sense, epic: ’was fitted’
ἀρίστους: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’the best’
ἀργείοις: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Achaeans/Greeks; masc. dat. pl.
ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀτρυτώνη: Ἀτρυτώνη — Atrytone, cult-title of Athena, traditionally ’the Unwearied’, though the derivation is uncertain; fem. voc. sg.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι)
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως) · also by metonymy ’war’ (ἔριδα Ἄρηος ’the strife of war’)
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’ · also neut. acc. sg.: ’the best (thing)’ (μέγ’ ἄριστον ’by far the best’)
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’) · also aor. 3 pl. with a predicate: ’became, fell’ (ἀκὴν ἐγένοντο ’fell silent’)
ἐγγύθι: ἐγγύθι — near, close by; adv., + gen.: ’near Priam’s’
ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἐδύτην: δύω — go into, sink into; aor. 3 dual act., root aorist (ἔδυν): ’the two went into’
ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, notice, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’)
ἐπισταμένως: ἐπισταμένως — skilfully, knowingly, expertly; adv. (from ἐπίσταμαι)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain)
ἐρχομένω: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. masc. dual nom.: ’the two coming’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐόντων: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντων): ’being’ (πολλῶν περ ἐόντων ’though they were many’)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’his own’
ἑῷ: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-pers. reflexive possessive adj., masc. dat. sg.: ’her own’
ἔθελον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελον)
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause: ’(whoever) might come’ · also after ὁππότε in past sequence, of an awaited event: ’should come’ (ποτιδέγμενοι ὁππότ’ ἄρ’ ἔλθοι ’waiting for when he should come’) · also after ἐπεὶ ἂν, potential: ’he would come’
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔντοσθεν: ἔντοσθεν — inside, within; adv., with a gen.: ’inside (the city)’
ἔπε: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl. (ἔπεα), elided (ἔπε’), epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’)
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλοι: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would take’
ἕπεσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany, go with; pres. inf.: ’to go with, accompany’
ἕποιτο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid. dep., potential with κε: ’would follow’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it followed’
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠρᾶτο: ἀράομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἀ- → ἠ-)
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἡμέας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; acc. pl., epic ἡμέας (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’)
ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἧκεν: ἵημι — send, hurl, let fly; aor. 3 sg. (ἧκα), ν-movable: ’hurled’
ἱμᾶσιν: ἱμάς — leather strap, thong; masc. dat. pl.
ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης)
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic Ὀδυσσῆος (double σ, metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀρμενίδαο: Ὀρμενίδης — son of Ormenus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
ὀρυκτὴν: ὀρυκτός — dug (verbal adj. of ὀρύσσω); fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τάφρον
ὀρφναίην: ὀρφναῖος — dark, murky; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (= Attic -αν)
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’)
ὁμοῖον: ὅμοιος — like, similar; neut. nom. sg., predicate (epic ὁμοῖος = Attic ὅμοιος): ’alike’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τινά, predicate of an infinitive: ’like (him)’
ὁρόων: ὁράω — see, look; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶν)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὄβριμος: ὄβριμος — mighty, stout, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares · also epithet of Hector: ’mighty’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅθεν: ὅθεν — from where, whence; relative adv.
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
